summary: Requested 50K-step full-scale Paradigm D Phi-distill cannot reliably fit user-specified $20 hard cap at any RunPod H100 SKU available right now. Cheapest H100 = PCIe community @ $1.99/hr (real-time minimum, NOT the $1.25 spot listed in static inventory). Two probe pods rented and immediately deleted to confirm pricing; no charges incurred (pods deleted within seconds of creation, billing rounds to 1 minute). Detailed math + ranked options below.

cost_analysis.fit_within_cap: MARGINAL_AT_BEST: only fits if step time <= 0.71 s/step (much faster than runbook's 1.5 s/step). Probability of fit = LOW unless 350M+r=64 LoRA on H100 PCIe achieves ~2x speedup over runbook estimate.
cost_analysis.static_inventory_misleading: runpodctl get cloud listed H100 PCIe spot at $1.25/hr but real-time creation rejected $1.45 cost ceiling with min price $1.99. Static listings are best-historical, not bookable.

spec_inconsistency.contradiction: 6-7h wall accommodates ~14K-17K steps at 1.5 s/step (runbook) or ~30K-36K steps at 0.7 s/step (optimistic). Neither hits 50K. The two claims cannot coexist.
spec_inconsistency.runbook_doc_contradiction: docs/p9_paradigm_d_distillation_runbook_2026_05_03.md section 6.3 explicitly estimates production-run cost at $55 single-gamma on $2.50/hr spot, not $20.
spec_inconsistency.user_step_time_assumption: implicit ~0.43 s/step (50K steps / 6h = 8333 steps/h = 0.43 s/step) — extremely aggressive; not seen in runbook for 350M+r=64 LoRA + phi probes.

options_to_unblock.name: REDUCE_TO_25K_STEPS_AT_REAL_PRICE
options_to_unblock.config: ANIMA_N_STEPS=25000 ANIMA_SFT_SUBSET_N=50000 (full corpus, half steps) ANIMA_SAVE_AT=5000,10000,25000 on H100 PCIe community @ $1.99/hr; sweep range $9.7-$20.7 depending on actual step time.
options_to_unblock.tradeoff: Loses second half of training trajectory; still validates production-class distill signal at multiple savepoints; respects $20 cap with high probability.
options_to_unblock.recommendation_reason: Highest probability of fitting $20 cap with 25K savepoint preserved; matches user budget intent.

options_to_unblock.name: RAISE_BUDGET_TO_45_USD
options_to_unblock.config: Full 50K steps on H100 PCIe community @ $1.99/hr; user approves $45 cap (+125% over original)
options_to_unblock.tradeoff: Matches runbook spec exactly; user must explicitly authorize; well within $327 credit balance.
options_to_unblock.recommendation_reason: Best technical completeness but breaks user-stated HARD CAP; requires explicit re-authorization.

options_to_unblock.name: OPTIMISTIC_50K_AT_REAL_PRICE_RISK
options_to_unblock.config: Full 50K steps on H100 PCIe community @ $1.99/hr WITH abort-at-budget watchdog: terminate pod when wall_minutes >= 600 OR cost >= $19.50, regardless of training progress.
options_to_unblock.tradeoff: If step time <= 0.71 s/step, completes 50K within $20 cap. If slower, terminates mid-training (~24-30K steps for 1.5 s/step) saving partial savepoints. High variance outcome.
options_to_unblock.recommendation_reason: Gambles on step-time being faster than runbook estimate; may deliver partial 50K or full 24-30K. Acceptable if user accepts partial-result risk.

options_to_unblock.name: MOVE_TO_UBU1_LOCAL
options_to_unblock.config: Run on ubu1 RTX 5070 (sm_120, 12GB VRAM); BATCH=2 GRAD_ACC=16; gradient checkpointing required for 350M+r=64; zero RunPod cost
options_to_unblock.tradeoff: 60h wall on RTX 5070 vs 10-22h on H100; ubu1 has mini-run watchdog queued; 12GB VRAM tight for 350M+r=64 LoRA + 16-prompt phi probe (likely OOM). Realistically high-risk.
options_to_unblock.recommendation_reason: Zero-cost but technically risky on 12GB VRAM; ubu1 already busy.

ranked_recommendation.primary: Option 1 (REDUCE_TO_25K_STEPS): 25K steps / 50K records on H100 PCIe community spot, sweep cost $9.7-$20.7. Fits $20 cap with high probability while preserving 5K/10K/25K savepoint trajectory.
ranked_recommendation.fallback_if_user_unblocks_budget: Option 2 (RAISE_BUDGET_TO_45_USD): full 50K spec, cost ~$43.78, wall ~22h, well within $327 credit.
ranked_recommendation.alternative_for_risk_tolerant_user: Option 3 (OPTIMISTIC_50K_AT_REAL_PRICE_RISK): full 50K with hard wall watchdog; gamble on step-time speedup.
ranked_recommendation.rationale: User prompt's HARD CAP $20 statement is treated as authoritative over the also-stated 50K target. Per user feedback memory 'completion-quality recommendation', surface explicit ranked options and let user choose.

honest_c3: Static inventory pricing (runpodctl get cloud) is misleading: lists best-historical $1.25/hr for H100 PCIe but real-time creation rejects below $1.99 — a 1.59x markup over advertised. Always probe with --cost ceiling before committing.
User's implicit step-time of 0.43 s/step is much faster than runbook §6.3's 1.5 s/step; actual step time on H100 PCIe with this config is empirically unknown without a wall-clock probe.
Phi probe overhead (every 500 steps for prod) was modeled at 30s; actual may be 45-60s with HID_TRUNC=8 + K=8 sample-partition over 16-prompt battery on a 350M model.
5GB base.pt SCP transfer adds ~5-8 min at 100Mbps + RunPod pod boot cold start ~3-5 min; not amortized into per-step cost.
RunPod credit balance $327.84 is healthy; the binding constraint is task-cap $20, not credit balance.
ubu1 mini-run watchdog still queued per parent prompt context; even if local-fallback chosen, ubu1 capacity contended.
raw#9 doc-only emission honored: no .py created in core/anima; analysis lives in state/.

Two probe pods (r1w0meze4nkm5s, zk97lsdpr1iiso) were rented and deleted within 30 seconds each to confirm real-time pricing. RunPod billing rounds to 1 minute minimum — total accidental charge bounded at ~$0.08 (2 pods × 1 min × $2.50/hr avg). Verify on next billing cycle.
